options.name: base
options.description: Search Base, Search base is a string of 4 to 64 alpha-numeric characters; It must start with an alphabetical character; Special Symbols like dot(.), comma(,), hyphen(-), underscore(_), equal-to(=) are allowed.

options.name: ca
options.description: CA certificate file path. Required when I(encry=StartTLS).

options.name: ce
options.description: Certificate file path. Required when I(encry=StartTLS).

options.name: cn
options.description: Common name type. Required when I(encry=StartTLS).

options.name: dn
options.description: Bind DN. Bind DN is a string of 4 to 64 alpha-numeric characters; It must start with an alphabetical character; Special Symbols like dot(.), comma(,), hyphen(-), underscore(_), equal-to(=) are allowed.

options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: pk
options.description: Private Key file path. Required when I(encry=StartTLS).

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.
